topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: QNAP NAS devices running Photo Station contain an improper access control vulnerability allowing remote attackers to gain unauthorized access to the system.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: QNAP Photo Station Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: QNAP devices running Photo Station contain an external control of file name or path vulnerability allowing remote attackers to access or modify system files.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: QNAP NAS Improper Authorization Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: QNAP NAS running HBS 3 contains an improper authorization vulnerability which can allow remote attackers to log in to a device.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: QNAP NAS File Station Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: A cross-site scripting vulnerability affecting QNAP NAS File Station could allow remote attackers to inject malicious code.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: QNAP NAS File Station Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: A command injection vulnerability affecting QNAP NAS File Station could allow remote attackers to run commands.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: QNAP NAS File Station Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: A cross-site scripting vulnerability affecting QNAP NAS File Station could allow remote attackers to inject malicious code.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: QNAP QTS Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: QNAP QTS contains an improper input validation vulnerability allowing remote attackers to inject code on the system.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Progress MOVEit Transfer SQL Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Progress MOVEit Transfer contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to MOVEit Transfer's database. Depending on the database engine being used (MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, or Azure SQL), an attacker may be able to infer information about the structure and contents of the database in addition to executing SQL statements that alter or delete database elements.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Progress WhatsUp Gold SQL Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Progress WhatsUp Gold contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to retrieve the user's encrypted password if the application is configured with only a single user.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Progress WS_FTP Server Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Progress WS_FTP Server contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in the Ad Hoc Transfer module that allows an authenticated attacker to execute remote commands on the underlying operating system.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Progress LoadMaster Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Progress LoadMaster contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an un-authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the LoadMaster appliance by exploiting unsanitized input in multiple command endpoints.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Progress WhatsUp Gold Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Progress WhatsUp Gold contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to achieve remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Progress Kemp LoadMaster OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Progress Kemp LoadMaster contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access the system through the LoadMaster management interface, enabling arbitrary system command execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Progress Telerik Report Server Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Progress Telerik Report Server contains an authorization bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows an attacker to obtain unauthorized access.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability through RadAsyncUpload which leads to code execution on the server in the context of the w3wp.exe process.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX and Sitefinity Cryptographic Weakness Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX and Sitefinity have a cryptographic weakness in Telerik.Web.UI.dll that can be exploited to disclose encryption keys (Telerik.Web.UI.DialogParametersEncryptionKey and/or the MachineKey), perform cross-site-scripting (XSS) attacks, compromise the ASP.NET ViewState, and/or upload and download files.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zoho ManageEngine Multiple Products Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Multiple Zoho ManageEngine products contain an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability due to the usage of an outdated third-party dependency, Apache Santuario.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zoho ManageEngine Multiple Products Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Zoho ManageEngine PAM360, Password Manager Pro, and Access Manager Plus contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus contains an authentication bypass vulnerability affecting the REST API URLs which allow for remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus contains an unspecified vulnerability allowing for remote code execution when performing a password change or reset.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zoho Desktop Central Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Zoho Desktop Central contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code in the Desktop Central MSP server.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus before 11302 is vulnerable to authentication bypass that allows a few REST-API URLs without authentication

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zoho ManageEngine Desktop Central File Upload Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Zoho ManageEngine Desktop Central contains a file upload vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus before 11306, ServiceDesk Plus MSP before 10530, and SupportCenter Plus before 11014 are vulnerable to unauthenticated remote code execution

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus (SDP) File Upload Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus (SDP) contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote users to upload files via login page customization.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Red Hat JBoss RichFaces Framework Expression Language Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Red Hat JBoss RichFaces Framework contains an expression language injection vulnerability via the UserResource resource. A remote, unauthenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability to execute malicious code using a chain of Java serialized objects via org.ajax4jsf.resource.UserResource$UriData.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Red Hat Polkit Out-of-Bounds Read and Write Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: The Red Hat polkit pkexec utility contains an out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation with administrative rights.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Red Hat JBoss Application Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: The JBoss Application Server, shipped with Red Hat Enterprise Application Platform 5.2, allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code via crafted serialized data.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Red Hat JBoss Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: The JMX-Console web application in JBossAs in Red Hat JBoss Enterprise Application Platform performs access control only for the GET and POST methods, which allows remote attackers to send requests to this application's GET handler by using a different method.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Red Hat Automatic Bug Reporting Tool Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Red Hat Automatic Bug Reporting Tool (ABRT) contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that could allow local users with certain permissions to gain privileges via a symlink attack on a file with a predictable name. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Red Hat JBoss Information Disclosure Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Unauthenticated access to the JBoss Application Server Web Console (/web-console) is blocked by default. However, it was found that this block was incomplete, and only blocked GET and POST HTTP verbs. A remote attacker could use this flaw to gain access to sensitive information.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Red Hat Polkit Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Red Hat Polkit contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability through the bypassing of credential checks for D-Bus requests, allowing for privilege escalation.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Red Hat Libuser Race Condition Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Red Hat libuser contains a race condition vulnerability that allows authenticated local users to corrupt the /etc/passwd file to cause a denial of service or privilege escalation.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Red Hat Linux JBoss Seam 2 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: JBoss Seam 2 (jboss-seam2), as used in JBoss Enterprise Application Platform 4.3.0 for Red Hat Linux, allows attackers to perform remote code execution. This vulnerability can only be exploited when the Java Security Manager is not properly configured.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Arm Mali GPU Kernel Driver Use-After-Free Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Arm Mali GPU Kernel Driver contains a use-after-free vulnerability that may allow a non-privileged user to gain root privilege and/or disclose information.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Arm Mali GPU Kernel Driver Use-After-Free Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Arm Mali GPU Kernel Driver contains a use-after-free vulnerability that may allow a non-privileged user to gain root privilege and/or disclose information.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Arm Mali GPU Kernel Driver Use-After-Free Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Arm Bifrost and Valhall GPU kernel drivers contain a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a local, non-privileged user to make improper GPU memory processing operations to gain access to already freed memory.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Arm Mali GPU Kernel Driver Unspecified Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Arm Mali GPU Kernel Driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows a non-privileged user to achieve write access to read-only memory pages.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Arm Mali GPU Kernel Driver Use-After-Free Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Arm Mali GPU Kernel Driver contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a local, non-privileged user to make improper GPU memory processing operations to gain access to already freed memory.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Arm Mali GPU Kernel Driver Information Disclosure Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Arm Mali GPU Kernel Driver contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows a non-privileged user to make valid GPU processing operations that expose sensitive kernel metadata.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Arm Mali Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) Use-After-Free Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Arm Mali Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) kernel driver contains a use-after-free vulnerability that may allow a non-privileged user to make improper operations on GPU memory to gain root privilege, and/or disclose information.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Arm Trusted Firmware Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Arm Trusted Firmware contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability allowing the non-secure (NS) world to trigger a system halt, overwrite secure data, or print out secure data when calling secure functions under the non-secure processing environment (NSPE) handler mode. This vulnerability affects Yealink Device Management servers.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Arm Mali Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) Unspecified Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Arm Mali Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) kernel driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that may allow a non-privileged user to gain write access to read-only memory, gain root privilege, corrupt memory, and modify the memory of other processes.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Juniper Junos OS EX Series and SRX Series PHP External Variable Modification Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Juniper Junos OS on EX Series and SRX Series contains a PHP external variable modification vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, network-based attacker to control an important environment variable. Using a crafted request, which sets the variable PHPRC, an attacker is able to modify the PHP execution environment allowing the injection und execution of code.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Juniper ScreenOS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Juniper ScreenOS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow unauthorized remote administrative access to the device.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Juniper Junos OS SRX Series Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Juniper Junos OS on SRX Series contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, network-based attacker to cause limited impact to the file system integrity. With a specific request to user.php that doesn't require authentication, an attacker is able to upload arbitrary files via J-Web, leading to a loss of integrity for a certain part of the file system, which may allow chaining to other vulnerabilities.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Juniper Junos OS EX Series PHP External Variable Modification Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Juniper Junos OS on EX Series contains a PHP external variable modification vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, network-based attacker to control certain, important environment variables. Using a crafted request an attacker is able to modify certain PHP environment variables, leading to partial loss of integrity, which may allow chaining to other vulnerabilities.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Juniper Junos OS EX Series Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Juniper Junos OS on EX Series contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, network-based attacker to cause limited impact to the file system integrity. With a specific request to installAppPackage.php that doesn't require authentication, an attacker is able to upload arbitrary files via J-Web, leading to a loss of integrity for a certain part of the file system, which may allow chaining to other vulnerabilities.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Juniper Junos OS Improper Isolation or Compartmentalization Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Juniper Junos OS contains an improper isolation or compartmentalization vulnerability. This vulnerability could allows a local attacker with high privileges to inject arbitrary code.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Juniper Junos OS SRX Series Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Juniper Junos OS on SRX Series contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, network-based attacker to cause limited impact to the file system integrity. With a specific request to webauth_operation.php that doesn't require authentication, an attacker is able to upload arbitrary files via J-Web, leading to a loss of integrity for a certain part of the file system, which may allow chaining to other vulnerabilities.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Juniper Junos OS Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: A path traversal vulnerability in the HTTP/HTTPS service used by J-Web, Web Authentication, Dynamic-VPN (DVPN), Firewall Authentication Pass-Through with Web-Redirect, and Zero Touch Provisioning (ZTP) allows an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: IBM Aspera Faspex Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: IBM Aspera Faspex could allow a remote attacker to execute code on the system, caused by a YAML deserialization flaw.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: IBM Langflow Code Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Langflow contains a code injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve full remote code execution on default Langflow deployments.

topVulnerabilities.product: WebSphere Application Server and Server Hypervisor Edition
topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: IBM WebSphere Application Server and Server Hypervisor Edition Code Injection.
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Serialized-object interfaces in certain IBM analytics, business solutions, cognitive, IT infrastructure, and mobile and social products allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: IBM Planning Analytics Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: IBM Planning Analytics is vulnerable to a configuration overwrite that allows an unauthenticated user to login as "admin", and then execute code as root or SYSTEM via TM1 scripting.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: IBM Data Risk Manager Directory Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: IBM Data Risk Manager contains a directory traversal vulnerability that could allow a remote authenticated attacker to traverse directories and send a specially crafted URL request to download arbitrary files from the system.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: IBM Data Risk Manager Security Bypass Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: IBM Data Risk Manager contains a security bypass vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass security restrictions when configured with SAML authentication. By sending a specially crafted HTTP request, an attacker could exploit this vulnerability to bypass the authentication process and gain full administrative access to the system.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: IBM Data Risk Manager Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: IBM Data Risk Manager contains an unspecified vulnerability which could allow a remote, authenticated attacker to execute commands on the system.�

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: IBM InfoSphere BigInsights Invalid Input Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Certain APIs within BigInsights can take invalid input that might allow attackers unauthorized access to read, write, modify, or delete data.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: NETGEAR Multiple Devices Exposure of Sensitive Information Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Multiple NETGEAR devices are prone to admin password disclosure via simple crafted requests to the web management server.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: NETGEAR Multiple WAP Devices Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Multiple NETGEAR Wireless Access Point devices allows unauthenticated web pages to pass form input directly to the command-line interface. Exploitation allows for arbitrary code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: NETGEAR Multiple Routers Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: NETGEAR confirmed multiple routers allow unauthenticated web pages to pass form input directly to the command-line interface, permitting remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: NETGEAR WNR2000v5 Router Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: The NETGEAR WNR2000v5 router contains a buffer overflow which can be exploited to achieve remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: NETGEAR DGN2200 Devices OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: dnslookup.cgi on NETGEAR DGN2200 devices with firmware through 10.0.0.50 allows remote authenticated users to execute arbitrary OS commands

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: NETGEAR DGN2200 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: NETGEAR DGN2200 wireless routers contain a vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Netgear JGS516PE Devices Missing Function Level Access Control Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Netgear JGS516PE devices contain a missing function level access control vulnerability.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: NETGEAR Multiple Devices Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Multiple NETGEAR devices contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for authentication bypass and remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Mitel MiCollab Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Mitel MiCollab contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an attacker to gain unauthorized and unauthenticated access. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2024-55550, which allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read arbitrary files on the server.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Mitel MiVoice Connect Data Validation Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: The Service Appliance component in Mitel MiVoice Connect allows remote code execution due to incorrect data validation.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Mitel MiVoice Connect Code Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: The Director component in Mitel MiVoice Connect allows an authenticated attacker with internal network access to execute code within the context of the application.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Mitel MiVoice Connect Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: The Mitel Edge Gateway component of MiVoice Connect allows an authenticated attacker with internal network access to execute commands within the context of the system.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Mitel MiCollab Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Mitel MiCollab contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with administrative privileges to read local files within the system due to insufficient input sanitization. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2024-41713, which allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read arbitrary files on the server.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Mitel SIP Phones Argument Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Mitel 6800 Series, 6900 Series, and 6900w Series SIP Phones, including the 6970 Conference Unit, contain an argument injection vulnerability due to insufficient parameter sanitization during the boot process. Successful exploitation may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands within the context of the system.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: MiCollab, MiVoice Business Express Access Control Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: A vulnerability has been identified in MiCollab and MiVoice Business Express that may allow a malicious actor to gain unauthorized access to sensitive information and services, cause performance degradations or a denial of service condition on the affected system.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: F5 BIG-IP Configuration Utility Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: F5 BIG-IP Configuration utility contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability due to undisclosed requests that may allow an unauthenticated attacker with network access to the BIG-IP system through the management port and/or self IP addresses to execute system commands. This vulnerability can be used in conjunction with CVE-2023-46748.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: F5 BIG-IP Missing Authentication Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: F5 BIG-IP contains a missing authentication in critical function vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution, creation or deletion of files, or disabling services.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: F5 BIG-IP Traffic Management User Interface (TMUI) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: F5 BIG-IP Traffic Management User Interface (TMUI) contains a remote code execution vulnerability in undisclosed pages.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: F5 BIG-IP and BIG-IQ Centralized Management iControl REST Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: F5 BIG-IP and BIG-IQ Centralized Management contain a remote code execution vulnerability in the iControl REST interface that allows unauthenticated attackers with network access to execute system commands, create or delete files, and disable services.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: F5 BIG-IP Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: F5 BIG-IP APM contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow a threat actor to achieve remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: F5 BIG-IP Configuration Utility SQL Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: F5 BIG-IP Configuration utility contains an SQL injection vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with network access through the BIG-IP management port and/or self IP addresses to execute system commands. This vulnerability can be used in conjunction with CVE-2023-46747.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: F5 BIG-IP Traffic Management Microkernel Buffer Overflow
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: The Traffic Management Microkernel of BIG-IP ASM Risk Engine has a buffer overflow vulnerability, leading to a bypassing of URL-based access controls.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Sophos Web Appliance Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Sophos Web Appliance contains a command injection vulnerability in the warn-proceed handler that allows for remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Sophos Firewall Code Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: A code injection vulnerability in the User Portal and Webadmin of Sophos Firewall allows for remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: CyberoamOS (CROS) SQL Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: CyberoamOS (CROS) contains a SQL injection vulnerability in the WebAdmin that allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary SQL statements remotely.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Sophos XG Firewall Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Sophos XG Firewall contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via the "HTTP/S bookmark" feature.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Sophos Firewall Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: An authentication bypass vulnerability in User Portal and Webadmin of Sophos Firewall allows for remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Sophos SG UTM Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in the WebAdmin of Sophos SG UTM.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Sophos SFOS SQL Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Sophos Firewall operating system (SFOS) firmware contains a SQL injection vulnerability when configured with either the administration (HTTPS) service or the User Portal is exposed on the WAN zone. Successful exploitation may cause remote code execution to exfiltrate usernames and hashed passwords for the local device admin(s), portal admins, and user accounts used for remote access (but not external Active Directory or LDAP passwords).

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Jenkins Command Line Interface (CLI) Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Jenkins Command Line Interface (CLI) contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows attackers limited read access to certain files, which can lead to code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Jenkins Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Jenkins contains a remote code execution vulnerability. This vulnerability that could allowed attackers to transfer a serialized Java SignedObject object to the remoting-based Jenkins CLI, that would be deserialized using a new ObjectInputStream, bypassing the existing blocklist-based protection mechanism.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Jenkins Stapler Web Framework Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: A code execution vulnerability exists in the Stapler web framework used by Jenkins

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Jenkins User Interface (UI) Information Disclosure Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Jenkins User Interface (UI) contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows users to see the names of jobs and builds otherwise inaccessible to them on the "Fingerprints" pages.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Jenkins Matrix Project Plugin Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Jenkins Matrix Project plugin contains a vulnerability which can allow users to escape the sandbox, opening opportunity to perform remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Jenkins Script Security Plugin Sandbox Bypass Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Jenkins Script Security Plugin contains a protection mechanism failure, allowing an attacker to bypass the sandbox.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TP-Link Archer AX-21 Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: TP-Link Archer AX-21 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TP-Link Multiple Routers Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: TP-Link TL-WR940N V2/V4, TL-WR841N V8/V10, and TL-WR740N V1/V2 contain a command injection vulnerability via the component /userRpm/WlanNetworkRpm. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TP-Link Archer C7(EU) and TL-WR841N/ND(MS) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: TP-Link Archer C7(EU) and TL-WR841N/ND(MS) contain an OS command injection vulnerability that exists in the Parental Control page. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TP-link TL-WA855RE Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: TP-link TL-WA855RE contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated attacker (on the same network) to submit a TDDP_RESET POST request for a factory reset and reboot. The attacker can then obtain incorrect access control by setting a new administrative password. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TP-Link Multiple Archer Devices Directory Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Directory traversal vulnerability in multiple TP-Link Archer devices allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files via a .. (dot dot) in the PATH_INFO to login/.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TP-Link TL-WR841N Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: TP-Link TL-WR841N contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability within the httpd service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default, leading to the disclose of stored credentials. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: RARLAB WinRAR Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: RARLAB WinRAR contains a path traversal vulnerability affecting the Windows version of WinRAR. This vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code by crafting malicious archive files.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: RARLAB WinRAR Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: RARLAB WinRAR contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute code when a user attempts to view a benign file within a ZIP archive.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: RARLAB UnRAR Directory Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: RARLAB UnRAR on Linux and UNIX contains a directory traversal vulnerability, allowing an attacker to write to files during an extract (unpack) operation.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: RARLAB WinRAR Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: RARLAB WinRAR contains a path traversal vulnerability allowing an attacker to execute code in the context of the current user.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: WinRAR Absolute Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: WinRAR Absolute Path Traversal vulnerability leads to Remote Code Execution

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Langflow Missing Authentication Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Langflow contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the /api/v1/validate/code endpoint that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code via crafted HTTP requests.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Langflow Code Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Langflow contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow building public flows without requiring authentication.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Langflow Origin Validation Error Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Langflow contains an origin validation error vulnerability in which an overly permissive CORS configuration combined with a refresh token cookie configured as SameSite=None allows a malicious webpage to perform cross-origin requests that include credentials and successfully call the refresh endpoint. This could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary code and achieve full system compromise via obtained tokens that permit access to authenticated endpoints.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Langflow Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Langflow contains an inclusion of functionality from untrusted control sphere vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Langflow Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Langflow contains an authorization bypass through user-controlled key vulnerability which allows an authenticated attacker to execute any flow belonging to another user by specifying the victim's flow ID in the request.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: PaperCut MF/NG Improper Access Control Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: PaperCut MF/NG contains an improper access control vulnerability within the SetupCompleted class that allows authentication bypass and code execution in the context of system.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: PaperCut NG/MF Improper Authentication Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: PaperCut NG/MF contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations via the SecurityRequestFilter class.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: PaperCut NG/MF Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: PaperCut NG/MF contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that allows an attacker to manipulate system configuration parameters and execute arbitrary Java bytecode residing on the application classpath under the security context of the PaperCut server process. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-81578.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: PaperCut NG/MF Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: PaperCut NG/MF contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to modify certain system configurations. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-82078.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: PaperCut NG/MF Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: PaperCut NG/MF contains a cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability, which, under specific conditions, could potentially enable an attacker to alter security settings or execute arbitrary code.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: DrayTek Multiple Vigor Routers OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: DrayTek Vigor3900, Vigor2960, and Vigor300B devices contain an OS command injection vulnerability in cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi/cvmcfgupload that allows for remote code execution via shell metacharacters in a filename when the text/x-python-script content type is used.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: DrayTek Vigor Routers OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: DrayTek Vigor2960, Vigor300B, and Vigor3900 routers contain an OS command injection vulnerability due to an unknown function of the file /cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi/apmcfgupload of the component web management interface.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Draytek VigorConnect Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Draytek VigorConnect contains a path traversal vulnerability in the file download functionality of the WebServlet endpoint. An unauthenticated attacker could leverage this vulnerability to download arbitrary files from the underlying operating system with root privileges.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Draytek VigorConnect Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Draytek VigorConnect contains a path traversal vulnerability in the DownloadFileServlet endpoint. An unauthenticated attacker could leverage this vulnerability to download arbitrary files from the underlying operating system with root privileges.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Multiple DrayTek Vigor Routers Web Management Page Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: DrayTek Vigor3900, Vigor2960, and Vigor300B routers contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: GNU InetUtils Argument Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: GNU InetUtils contains an argument injection vulnerability in telnetd that could allow for remote authentication bypass via a "-f root" value for the USER environment variable.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: GNU Bash OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: GNU Bash contains an OS command injection vulnerability which allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands via a crafted environment.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: GNU C Library Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: GNU C Library's dynamic loader ld.so contains a buffer overflow vulnerability when processing the GLIBC_TUNABLES environment variable, allowing a local attacker to execute code with elevated privileges.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: GNU Bourne-Again Shell (Bash) Arbitrary Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: GNU Bash through 4.3 processes trailing strings after function definitions in the values of environment variables, which allows remote attackers to execute code.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: GNU Bourne-Again Shell (Bash) Arbitrary Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: GNU Bash through 4.3 processes trailing strings after function definitions in the values of environment variables, which allows remote attackers to execute code. This CVE correctly remediates the vulnerability in CVE-2014-6271.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: WordPress Core Interpretation Conflict Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: WordPress Core contains an interpretation conflict vulnerability that could allow an attacker to perform SQL Injection and achieve Remote Code Execution. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-60137.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: WordPress Core SQL Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: WordPress Core contains a SQL injection vulnerability when a plugin or theme passes untrusted input to the parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-63030 to allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain remote code execution on default WordPress installations.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: WordPress Snap Creek Duplicator Plugin File Download Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: WordPress Snap Creek Duplicator plugin contains a file download vulnerability when an administrator creates a new copy of their site that allows an attacker to download the generated files from their Wordpress dashboard. This vulnerability affects Duplicator and Dulplicator Pro.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: WordPress File Manager Plugin Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: WordPress File Manager plugin contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows unauthenticated users to execute PHP code and upload malicious files on a target site.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: WordPress Social Warfare Plugin Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: WordPress Social Warfare plugin contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. This vulnerability affects Social Warfare and Social Warfare Pro.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Drupal Core SQL Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Drupal Core contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation and remote code execution via specially crafted requests sent with the database abstraction API.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Drupal Core Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: A remote code execution vulnerability exists within multiple subsystems of Drupal that can allow attackers to exploit multiple attack vectors on a Drupal site.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Drupal Core Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Drupal Core contains a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow an attacker to exploit multiple attack vectors on a Drupal site, resulting in complete site compromise.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Drupal Core Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: In Drupal Core, some field types do not properly sanitize data from non-form sources. This can lead to arbitrary PHP code execution in some cases.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Drupal core Un-restricted Upload of File
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Improper sanitization in the extension file names is present in Drupal core.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: N-able N-central Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: N-able N-central contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel allows for authentication bypass and account takeover in N-central. This vulnerability is the result of an incomplete patch for CVE-2026-18556.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: N-able N-central Static Code Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: N-able N-central contains a static code injection vulnerability that could allow for pre-authentication remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: N-able N-central Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: N-able N-central contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that allows for authentication bypass.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: N-able N-Central Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: N-able N-Central contains a command injection vulnerability via improper sanitization of user input.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: N-able N-Central Insecure Deserialization Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: N-able N-Central contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that could lead to command execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Broadcom VMware vCenter Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow a threat actor with network access to vCenter to execute arbitrary code.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Broadcom VMware vCenter Server Out-of-bounds Write Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Broadcom VMware vCenter Server contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the implementation of the DCERPC protocol. This could allow a malicious actor with network access to vCenter Server to send specially crafted network packets, potentially leading to remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Broadcom VMware Aria Operations Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Broadcom VMware Aria Operations formerly known as vRealize Operations (vROps) contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands, potentially leading to remote code execution during support‑assisted product migration.

topVulnerabilities.product: VMware Aria Operations and VMware Tools
topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Broadcom VMware Aria Operations and VMware Tools Privilege Defined with Unsafe Actions Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Broadcom VMware Aria Operations and VMware Tools contain a privilege defined with unsafe actions vulnerability. A malicious local actor with non-administrative privileges having access to a VM with VMware Tools installed and managed by Aria Operations with SDMP enabled may exploit this vulnerability to escalate privileges to root on the same VM.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Broadcom Brocade Fabric OS Code Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Broadcom Brocade Fabric OS contains a code injection vulnerability that allows a local user with administrative privileges to execute arbitrary code with full root privileges.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Exim Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Exim contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in the base64d function part of the SMTP listener that may allow for remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Exim Mail Transfer Agent (MTA) Improper Input Validation
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Improper validation of recipient address in deliver_message() function in /src/deliver.c may lead to remote command execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Exim Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Heap-based buffer overflow in the string_vformat function in string.c in Exim before 4.70 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via an SMTP session.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Exim Out-of-bounds Write Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Exim contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Exim Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Exim allows local users to gain privileges by leveraging the ability of the exim user account to specify an alternate configuration file with a directive that contains arbitrary commands.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: JetBrains TeamCity Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: JetBrains TeamCity contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows an attacker to perform admin actions.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: JetBrains TeamCity Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: JetBrains TeamCity contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows for remote code execution on TeamCity Server.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: JetBrains TeamCity Relative Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: JetBrains TeamCity contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow limited admin actions to be performed.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: JetBrains TeamCity Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: JetBrains TeamCity contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated remote code execution via the agent polling protocol.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Veeam Backup and Replication Deserialization Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Veeam Backup and Replication contains a deserialization vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated user to perform remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Veeam Backup & Replication Cloud Connect Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Veeam Backup & Replication Cloud Connect component contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user operating within the backup infrastructure network perimeter to obtain encrypted credentials stored in the configuration database. This may lead to an attacker gaining access to the backup infrastructure hosts.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Veeam Backup & Replication Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: The Veeam Distribution Service in the Backup & Replication application allows unauthenticated users to access internal API functions. A remote attacker can send input to the internal API which may lead to uploading and executing of malicious code.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Veeam Backup & Replication Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: The Veeam Distribution Service in the Backup & Replication application allows unauthenticated users to access internal API functions. A remote attacker can send input to the internal API which may lead to uploading and executing of malicious code.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SimpleHelp Missing Authorization Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: SimpleHelp contains a missing authorization vulnerability that could allow low-privileged technicians to create API keys with excessive permissions. These API keys can be used to escalate privileges to the server admin role.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SimpleHelp Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: SimpleHelp remote support software contains multiple path traversal vulnerabilities that allow unauthenticated remote attackers to download arbitrary files from the SimpleHelp host via crafted HTTP requests. These files may include server configuration files and hashed user passwords.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SimpleHelp Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: SimpleHelp contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the OIDC authentication flow. When OIDC authentication is configured, identity tokens submitted during login are accepted without verifying their cryptographic signature. In a vulnerable configuration, a remote, unauthenticated attacker can submit a forged token containing arbitrary identity claims to obtain a fully authenticated technician session. In some configurations, this may also allow bypass of multi-factor authentication.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SimpleHelp Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: SimpleHelp contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows admin users to upload arbitrary files anywhere on the file system by uploading a crafted zip file (i.e. zip slip). This can be exploited to execute arbitrary code on the host in the context of the SimpleHelp server user.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Gladinet CentreStack and Triofox Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Gladinet CentreStack and Triofox contains a use of hard-coded cryptographic key vulnerability in the way that the application manages keys used for ViewState integrity verification. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to forge ViewState payloads for server-side deserialization, allowing for remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Gladinet Triofox Improper Access Control Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Gladinet Triofox contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows access to initial setup pages even after setup is complete.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Gladinet CentreStack and Triofox Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Gladinet CentreStack and Triofox contains a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability that allows unintended disclosure of system files.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Gladinet CentreStack and Triofox Hard Coded Cryptographic Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Gladinet CentreStack and TrioFox contain a hardcoded cryptographic keys vulnerability for their implementation of the AES cryptoscheme. This vulnerability degrades security for public exposed endpoints that may make use of it and may offer arbitrary local file inclusion when provided a specially crafted request without authentication.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Fortra GoAnywhere MFT Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Fortra GoAnywhere MFT contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability allows an actor with a validly forged license response signature to deserialize an arbitrary actor-controlled object, possibly leading to command injection.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Fortra GoAnywhere MFT Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Fortra (formerly, HelpSystems) GoAnywhere MFT contains a pre-authentication remote code execution vulnerability in the License Response Servlet due to deserializing an attacker-controlled object.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Fortra Cobalt Strike User Interface Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Fortra Cobalt Strike User Interface contains an unspecified vulnerability rooted in Java Swing that may allow remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Fortra Cobalt Strike Teamserver Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Fortra Cobalt Strike contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in Teamserver that would allow an attacker to set a malformed username in the Beacon configuration, allowing them to execute code remotely.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Sangoma FreePBX Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Sangoma FreePBX contains an authentication bypass vulnerability due to insufficiently sanitized user-supplied data allows unauthenticated access to FreePBX Administrator leading to arbitrary database manipulation and remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Sangoma FreePBX OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Sangoma FreePBX Endpoint Manager contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow for a post-authentication command injection by an authenticated known user via the testconnection -> check_ssh_connect() function. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to potentially obtain remote access to the system as an asterisk user.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Sangoma Switchvox SQL Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Sangoma Switchvox contains a SQL injection vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary SQL statements against the backend PostgreSQL database using a single crafted request, including database operations and remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Sangoma FreePBX Improper Authentication Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Sangoma FreePBX contains an improper authentication vulnerability that potentially allows unauthorized users to bypass password authentication and access services provided by the FreePBX admin.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ubiquiti UniFi OS Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Ubiquiti UniFi OS contains an improper input validation vulnerability which could allow a malicious actor with access to the network to conduct command injection.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ubiquiti UniFi OS Improper Access Control Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Ubiquiti UniFi OS contains an improper access control vulnerability which could allow a malicious actor with access to the network to make unauthorized changes to the system.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ubiquiti UniFi OS Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Ubiquiti UniFi OS contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow a malicious actor with access to the network to access files on the underlying system that could be manipulated to access an underlying account.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ubiquiti AirOS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Certain Ubiquiti devices contain a command injection vulnerability via a GET request to stainfo.cgi.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: GitLab Community and Enterprise Editions Improper Access Control Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: GitLab Community and Enterprise Editions contain an improper access control vulnerability. This allows an attacker to trigger password reset emails to be sent to an unverified email address to ultimately facilitate an account takeover.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: GitLab Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: GitLab contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability when requests to the internal network for webhooks are enabled.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: GitLab Community and Enterprise Editions Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: GitHub Community and Enterprise Editions that utilize the ability to upload images through GitLab Workhorse are vulnerable to remote code execution. Workhorse passes image file extensions through ExifTool, which improperly validates the image files.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: GitLab Community and Enterprise Editions Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: GitLab Community and Enterprise Editions contain a server-side request forgery vulnerability which could allow unauthorized external users to perform Server Side Requests via the CI Lint API.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Sitecore CMS and Experience Platform (XP) Deserialization Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Sitecore CMS and Experience Platform (XP) contain a deserialization vulnerability in the Sitecore.Security.AntiCSRF module that allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code by sending a serialized .NET object in the HTTP POST parameter __CSRFTOKEN.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Sitecore XP Remote Command Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Sitcore XP contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Sitecore Multiple Products Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Sitecore Experience Manager (XM), Experience Platform (XP), Experience Commerce (XC), and Managed Cloud contain a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability involving the use of default machine keys. This flaw allows attackers to exploit exposed ASP.NET machine keys to achieve remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Sitecore CMS and Experience Platform (XP) Deserialization Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Sitecore CMS and Experience Platform (XP) contain a deserialization vulnerability in the Sitecore.Security.AntiCSRF module that allows an authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code by sending a serialized .NET object in the HTTP POST parameter __CSRFTOKEN.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Craft CMS Code Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Craft CMS contains a code injection vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Craft CMS Code Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Craft CMS contains a code injection vulnerability. Users with affected versions are vulnerable to remote code execution if their php.ini configuration has `register_argc_argv` enabled.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Craft CMS Code Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Craft CMS contains a code injection vulnerability caused by improper validation of the database backup path, ultimately enabling remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Craft CMS External Control of Assumed-Immutable Web Parameter Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Craft CMS contains an external control of assumed-immutable web parameter vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated client to introduce arbitrary values, such as PHP code, to a known local file location on the server. This vulnerability could be chained with CVE-2024-58136 as represented by CVE-2025-32432.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Kentico Xperience CMS Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Kentico Xperience CMS contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow an attacker to control administrative objects.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Kentico Xperience CMS Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Kentico Xperience CMS contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow an attacker to control administrative objects.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Kentico Xperience Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Kentico contains a failure to validate security headers. This deserialization can led to unauthenticated remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Kentico Xperience Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Kentico Xperience contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user's Staging Sync Server to upload arbitrary data to path relative locations.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: GIGABYTE Multiple Products Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: The GPCIDrv and GDrv low-level drivers in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU expose functionality to read and write arbitrary physical memory. This could be leveraged by a local attacker to elevate privileges.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: GIGABYTE Multiple Products Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: The GPCIDrv and GDrv low-level drivers in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU II expose functionality to read and write arbitrary physical memory. This could be leveraged by a local attacker to elevate privileges.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: GIGABYTE Multiple Products Unspecified Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: The GDrv low-level driver in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU II exposes ring0 memcpy-like functionality that could allow a local attacker to take complete control of the affected system.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: GIGABYTE Multiple Products Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: The GPCIDrv and GDrv low-level drivers in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU II expose functionality to read/write data from/to IO ports. This could be leveraged in a number of ways to ultimately run code with elevated privileges.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: WatchGuard Firebox Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: WatchGuard Firebox contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the OS iked process that may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: WatchGuard Firebox Out of Bounds Write Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: WatchGuard Fireware OS iked process contains an out of bounds write vulnerability in the OS iked process. This vulnerability may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code and affects both the mobile user VPN with IKEv2 and the branch office VPN using IKEv2 when configured with a dynamic gateway peer.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: WatchGuard Firebox and XTM Appliances Arbitrary Code Execution
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: On WatchGuard Firebox and XTM appliances, an unauthenticated user can execute arbitrary code.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: WatchGuard Firebox and XTM Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: WatchGuard Firebox and XTM appliances allow a remote attacker with unprivileged credentials to access the system with a privileged management session via exposed management access.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Accellion FTA OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Accellion FTA contains an OS command injection vulnerability exploited via a crafted POST request to various admin endpoints.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Accellion FTA Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Accellion FTA contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability exploited via a crafted POST request to wmProgressstat.html.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Accellion FTA OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Accellion FTA contains an OS command injection vulnerability exploited via a local web service call.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Accellion FTA SQL Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Accellion FTA contains a SQL injection vulnerability exploited via a crafted host header in a request to document_root.html.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Nagios XI OS Command Injection
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Nagios XI contains a vulnerability which can lead to OS command injection on the Nagios XI server.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Nagios XI Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Nagios XI contains a remote code execution vulnerability in which a user can modify the check_plugin executable and insert malicious commands to execute as root.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Nagios XI OS Command Injection
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Nagios XI contains a vulnerability which can lead to OS command injection on the Nagios XI server.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Nagios XI OS Command Injection
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Nagios XI contains a vulnerability which can lead to OS command injection on the Nagios XI server.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SmarterTools SmarterMail Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: SmarterTools SmarterMail contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the password reset API. The force-reset-password endpoint permits anonymous requests and fails to verify the existing password or a reset token when resetting system administrator accounts. This could allow an unauthenticated attacker to supply a target administrator username and a new password to reset the account, resulting in full administrative compromise of the SmarterMail instance.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SmarterTools SmarterMail Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: SmarterTools SmarterMail contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability in the ConnectToHub API method. This could allow the attacker to point the SmarterMail instance to a malicious HTTP server which serves the malicious OS command and could lead to command execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SmarterTools SmarterMail Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: SmarterTools SmarterMail contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to upload arbitrary files to any location on the mail server, potentially enabling remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Security Gateway Improper Authentication Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Check Point Security Gateway contains an improper authentication vulnerability in IKEv1 key exchange that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass user authentication and establish a remote access VPN connection without a valid user password.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Quantum Security Gateways Information Disclosure Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Check Point Quantum Security Gateways contain an unspecified information disclosure vulnerability. The vulnerability potentially allows an attacker to access information on Gateways connected to the internet, with IPSec VPN, Remote Access VPN or Mobile Access enabled. This issue affects several product lines from Check Point, including CloudGuard Network, Quantum Scalable Chassis, Quantum Security Gateways, and Quantum Spark Appliances.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Check Point SmartConsole Improper Authentication Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Check Point SmartConsole contains an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to obtain an application login token and use it to authenticate with full administrative privileges.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: CrushFTP Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: CrushFTP contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the HTTP authorization header that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to authenticate to any known or guessable user account (e.g., crushadmin), potentially leading to a full compromise.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: CrushFTP VFS Sandbox Escape Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: CrushFTP contains an unspecified sandbox escape vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to escape the CrushFTP virtual file system (VFS).

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: CrushFTP Unprotected Alternate Channel Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: CrushFTP contains an unprotected alternate channel vulnerability. When the DMZ proxy feature is not used, mishandles AS2 validation and consequently allows remote attackers to obtain admin access via HTTPS.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Qlik Sense HTTP Tunneling Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Qlik Sense contains an HTTP tunneling vulnerability that allows an attacker to escalate privileges and execute HTTP requests on the backend server hosting the software.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Qlik Sense Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Qlik Sense contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to create an anonymous session by sending maliciously crafted HTTP requests. This anonymous session could allow the attacker to send further requests to unauthorized endpoints.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Qlik Sense HTTP Tunneling Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Qlik Sense contains an HTTP tunneling vulnerability that allows an attacker to escalate privileges and execute HTTP requests on the backend server hosting the software.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Laravel Ignition File Upload Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Laravel Ignition contains a file upload vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute malicious code due to insecure usage of file_get_contents() and file_put_contents().

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Laravel Livewire Code Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Laravel Livewire contain a code injection vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote command execution in specific scenarios.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Laravel Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Laravel Framework contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability, allowing for remote command execution. This vulnerability may only be exploited if a malicious user has accessed the application encryption key (APP_KEY environment variable).

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ConnectWise ScreenConnect Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows an attacker with network access to the management interface to create a new, administrator-level account on affected devices.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ConnectWise ScreenConnect Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow an attacker to execute remote code or directly impact confidential data and critical systems.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ConnectWise ScreenConnect Improper Authentication Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains an improper authentication vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow a ViewState code injection attack, which could allow remote code execution if machine keys are compromised.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: OSGeo GeoServer GeoTools Eval Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: OSGeo GeoServer GeoTools contains an improper neutralization of directives in dynamically evaluated code vulnerability due to unsafely evaluating property names as XPath expressions. This allows unauthenticated attackers to conduct remote code execution via specially crafted input.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: OSGeo GeoServer JAI-EXT Code Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: OSGeo GeoServer JAI-EXT contains a code injection vulnerability that, when programs use jt-jiffle and allow Jiffle script to be provided via network request, could allow remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: OSGeo GeoServer Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: OSGeo GeoServer contains an improper restriction of XML external entity reference vulnerability that occurs when the application accepts XML input through a specific endpoint /geoserver/wms operation GetMap and could allow an attacker to define external entities within the XML request.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SysAid Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: SysAid Server (on-premises version) contains a path traversal vulnerability that leads to code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SysAid On-Prem Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: SysAid On-Prem contains an improper restriction of XML external entity reference vulnerability in the Server URL processing functionality, allowing for administrator account takeover and file read primitives.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SysAid On-Prem Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: SysAid On-Prem contains an improper restriction of XML external entity reference vulnerability in the Checkin processing functionality, allowing for administrator account takeover and file read primitives.

topVulnerabilities.product: Remote Support (RS) and Privileged Remote Access (PRA)
