topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: BeyondTrust Remote Support (RS) and Privileged Remote Access (PRA) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: BeyondTrust Remote Support (RS) and Privileged Remote Access (PRA)contain an OS command injection vulnerability. Successful exploitation could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute operating system commands in the context of the site user. Successful exploitation requires no authentication or user interaction and may lead to system compromise, including unauthorized access, data exfiltration, and service disruption.

topVulnerabilities.product: Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS)
topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS) Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS) contain a command injection vulnerability, which can allow an unauthenticated attacker to inject commands that are run as a site user.

topVulnerabilities.product: Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS)
topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS) contain an OS command injection vulnerability that can be exploited by an attacker with existing administrative privileges to upload a malicious file. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can allow a remote attacker to execute underlying operating system commands within the context of the site user.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Veritas Backup Exec Agent Improper Authentication Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Veritas Backup Exec (BE) Agent contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow an attacker unauthorized access to the BE Agent via SHA authentication scheme.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Veritas Backup Exec Agent Command Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Veritas Backup Exec (BE) Agent contains a command execution vulnerability that could allow an attacker to use a data management protocol command to execute a command on the BE Agent machine.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Veritas Backup Exec Agent File Access Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Veritas Backup Exec (BE) Agent contains a file access vulnerability that could allow an attacker to specially craft input parameters on a data management protocol command to access files on the BE Agent machine.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Dassault Systèmes DELMIA Apriso Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Dassault Systèmes DELMIA Apriso contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could lead to a remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Dassault Systèmes DELMIA Apriso Missing Authorization Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Dassault Systèmes DELMIA Apriso contains a missing authorization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to gain privileged access to the application.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Dassault Systèmes DELMIA Apriso Code Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Dassault Systèmes DELMIA Apriso contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: BerriAI LiteLLM SQL Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: BerriAI LiteLLM contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows an attacker to read data from the proxy's database and potentially modify it, leading to unauthorized access to the proxy and the credentials it manages.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: BerriAI LiteLLM Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: BerriAI LiteLLM contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow any authenticated user, including holders of low-privilege internal-user keys, to run arbitrary commands on the host.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: BerriAI LiteLLM Improper Authentication Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: BerriAI LiteLLM contains an improper authentication vulnerability in the MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to establish an authenticated MCP session using an arbitrary Bearer token.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: PHPMailer Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: PHPMailer contains a command injection vulnerability because it fails to sanitize user-supplied input. Specifically, this issue affects the 'mail()' function of 'class.phpmailer.php' script. An attacker can exploit this issue to execute arbitrary code within the context of the application. Failed exploit attempts will result in a denial-of-service condition.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: PHP FastCGI Process Manager (FPM) Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: In some versions of PHP in certain configurations of FPM setup, it is possible to cause FPM module to write past allocated buffers allowing the possibility of remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: PHP-CGI Query String Parameter Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: sapi/cgi/cgi_main.c in PHP, when configured as a CGI script, does not properly handle query strings, which allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ASUS Routers Improper Authentication Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: ASUS Lyra Mini and ASUS GT-AC2900 devices contain an improper authentication vulnerability that allows an attacker to gain unauthorized access to the administrative interface. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ASUS RT-AX55 Routers OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: ASUS RT-AX55 devices contain an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote, authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands. As represented by CVE-2023-41346.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ASUS Live Update Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: ASUS Live Update contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability client were distributed with unauthorized modifications introduced through a supply chain compromise. The modified builds could cause devices meeting specific targeting conditions to perform unintended actions. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: VMware Tanzu Spring Cloud Function Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: When using routing functionality in VMware Tanzu's Spring Cloud Function, it is possible for a user to provide a specially crafted SpEL as a routing-expression that may result in remote code execution and access to local resources.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: VMware Tanzu Spring Data Commons Property Binder Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Spring Data Commons contains a property binder vulnerability which can allow an attacker to perform remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: VMware Tanzu Spring Cloud Config Directory Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Spring, by VMware Tanzu, Cloud Config contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows applications to serve arbitrary configuration files.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Realtek SDK Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Realtek SDK contains an improper input validation vulnerability in the miniigd SOAP service that allows remote attackers to execute malicious code via a crafted NewInternalClient request.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Realtek Jungle SDK Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: RealTek Jungle SDK contains multiple memory corruption vulnerabilities which can allow an attacker to perform remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Realtek AP-Router SDK Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Realtek AP-Router SDK HTTP web server boa contains a buffer overflow vulnerability due to unsafe copies of some overly long parameters submitted in the form that lead to denial-of-service (DoS).

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TrueConf Server Code Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: TrueConf Server contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthorized remote attacker with network access via port 4307/TCP to use a specially crafted script to break out of the isolated environment and execute arbitrary code on the host system.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TrueConf Server Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: TrueConf Server contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which could allow a remote unauthorized attacker with network access via port 4307/TCP to execute an arbitrary script.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TrueConf Client Download of Code Without Integrity Check Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: TrueConf Client contains a download of code without integrity check vulnerability. An attacker who is able to influence the update delivery path can substitute a tampered update payload. If the payload is executed or installed by the updater, this may result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the updating process or user.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Kaseya VSA SQL Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: ConnectWise ManagedITSync integration for Kaseya VSA is vulnerable to unauthenticated remote commands that allow full direct access to the Kaseya VSA database.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Kaseya Virtual System/Server Administrator (VSA) Information Disclosure Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Kaseya Virtual System/Server Administrator (VSA) contains an information disclosure vulnerability allowing an attacker to obtain the sessionId that can be used to execute further attacks against the system.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Kaseya VSA Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Kaseya VSA RMM allows unprivileged remote attackers to execute PowerShell payloads on all managed devices.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ImageMagick Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: ImageMagick contains an improper input validation vulnerability that affects the EPHEMERAL, HTTPS, MVG, MSL, TEXT, SHOW, WIN, and PLT coders. This allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via shell metacharacters in a crafted image.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ImageMagick Arbitrary File Deletion Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: ImageMagick contains an unspecified vulnerability that could allow users to delete files by using ImageMagick's 'ephemeral' pseudo protocol, which deletes files after reading.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ImageMagick Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: ImageMagick contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows attackers to perform server-side request forgery (SSRF) via a crafted image.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Rails Ruby on Rails Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Rails Ruby on Rails contains a path traversal vulnerability in Action View. Specially crafted accept headers in combination with calls to `render file:` can cause arbitrary files on the target server to be rendered, disclosing the file contents.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ruby on Rails Directory Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Directory traversal vulnerability in Action View in Ruby on Rails allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ruby on Rails Directory Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Directory traversal vulnerability in actionpack/lib/abstract_controller/base.rb in the implicit-render implementation in Ruby on Rails allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files via a crafted request.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: DotNetNuke (DNN) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: DotNetNuke (DNN) contains a vulnerability that may allow for remote code execution via cookie deserialization.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: DotNetNuke (DNN) Inadequate Encryption Strength Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: DotNetNuke (DNN) contains an inadequate encryption strength vulnerability resulting from the use of a weak encryption algorithm to protect input parameters.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: DotNetNuke (DNN) Inadequate Encryption Strength Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: DotNetNuke (DNN) contains an inadequate encryption strength vulnerability resulting from the use of a weak encryption algorithm to protect input parameters. This CVE ID resolves an incomplete patch for CVE-2018-15811.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Elasticsearch Groovy Scripting Engine Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: The Groovy scripting engine in Elasticsearch allows remote attackers to bypass the sandbox protection mechanism and execute arbitrary shell commands.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Kibana Arbitrary Code Execution
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Kibana contain an arbitrary code execution flaw in the Timelion visualizer.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Elasticsearch Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Elasticsearch enables dynamic scripting, which allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary MVEL expressions and Java code.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SaltStack Salt Shell Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: SaltStack Salt allows an unauthenticated user with network access to the Salt API to use shell injections to run code on the Salt API using the SSH client. This vulnerability affects any users running the Salt API.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SaltStack Salt Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: SaltStack Salt contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the salt-master process ClearFuncs due to improperly validating method calls. The vulnerability allows a remote user to access some methods without authentication, which can be used to retrieve user tokens from the salt master and/or run commands on salt minions. Salt users who follow fundamental internet security guidelines and best practices are not affected by this vulnerability.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SaltStack Salt Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: SaltStack Salt contains a path traversal vulnerability in the salt-master process ClearFuncs which allows directory access to authenticated users. Salt users who follow fundamental internet security guidelines and best practices are not affected by this vulnerability.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Tenda AC11 Router Stack Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Tenda AC11 devices contain a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in /goform/setmac which allows attackers to execute code via a crafted post request.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Tenda AC1900 Router AC15 Model Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Tenda AC1900 Router AC15 Model contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute system commands via the deviceName POST parameter.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Tenda AC7, AC9, and AC10 Routers Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Tenda AC7, AC9, and AC10 devices contain a command injection vulnerability due to  the "formsetUsbUnload" function executes a dosystemCmd function with untrusted input. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to execute OS commands via a crafted goform/setUsbUnload request.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: WhatsApp Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: A vulnerability in WhatsApp Desktop when paired with WhatsApp for iPhone allows cross-site scripting and local file reading.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Meta Platforms WhatsApp Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Meta Platforms WhatsApp contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability due to an incomplete authorization of linked device synchronization messages. This vulnerability could allow an unrelated user to trigger processing of content from an arbitrary URL on a target’s device.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: WhatsApp VOIP Stack Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: A buffer overflow vulnerability in WhatsApp VOIP stack allowed remote code execution via specially crafted series of RTCP packets sent to a target phone number.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TeleMessage TM SGNL Initialization of a Resource with an Insecure Default Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: TeleMessage TM SGNL contains an initialization of a resource with an insecure default vulnerability. This vulnerability relies on how the Spring Boot Actuator is configured with an exposed heap dump endpoint at a /heapdump URI.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TeleMessage TM SGNL Hidden Functionality Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: TeleMessage TM SGNL contains a hidden functionality vulnerability in which the archiving backend holds cleartext copies of messages from TM SGNL application users.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TeleMessage TM SGNL Exposure of Core Dump File to an Unauthorized Control Sphere Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: TeleMessage TM SGNL contains an exposure of core dump file to an unauthorized control sphere Vulnerability. This vulnerability is based on a JSP application in which the heap content is roughly equivalent to a "core dump" in which a password previously sent over HTTP would be included in this dump.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cleo Multiple Products Unrestricted File Upload Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Cleo Harmony, VLTrader, and LexiCom, which are managed file transfer products, contain an unrestricted file upload and download vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution with elevated privileges.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cleo Multiple Products Unauthenticated File Upload Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Cleo Harmony, VLTrader, and LexiCom, which are managed file transfer products, contain an unrestricted file upload vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to import and execute arbitrary bash or PowerShell commands on the host system by leveraging the default settings of the Autorun directory.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: CyberPanel Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: CyberPanel contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that allows for authentication bypass and the execution of arbitrary commands using shell metacharacters in the statusfile property.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: CyberPanel Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: CyberPanel contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute commands as root.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Metabase SQL Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Metabase contains a SQL Injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to inject arbitrary SQL into the Metabase application database, which can give them administrator access to the instance. From there, the attacker could change the application configuration, steal stored credentials for the connected databases, read any data accessible through those connections, and export data.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Metabase GeoJSON API Local File Inclusion Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Metabase contains a local file inclusion vulnerability in the custom map support in the API to read GeoJSON formatted data.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: CWP Control Web Panel OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: CWP Control Web Panel (formerly CentOS Web Panel) contains an OS command Injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote code execution via shell metacharacters in the t_total parameter in a filemanager changePerm request. A valid non-root username must be known.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: CWP Control Web Panel OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: CWP Control Web Panel (formerly CentOS Web Panel) contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute commands via shell metacharacters in the login parameter.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Dahua IP Camera Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Dahua IP cameras and related products contain an authentication bypass vulnerability when the loopback device is specified by the client during authentication.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Dahua IP Camera Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Dahua IP cameras and related products contain an authentication bypass vulnerability when the NetKeyboard type argument is specified by the client during authentication.

topVulnerabilities.product: Utah, Vancouver, and Washington DC Now Platform
topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ServiceNow Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: ServiceNow Utah, Vancouver, and Washington DC Now Platform releases contain a jelly template injection vulnerability in UI macros. An unauthenticated user could exploit this vulnerability to execute code remotely.

topVulnerabilities.product: Utah, Vancouver, and Washington DC Now Platform
topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ServiceNow Incomplete List of Disallowed Inputs Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: ServiceNow Washington DC, Vancouver, and earlier Now Platform releases contain an incomplete list of disallowed inputs vulnerability in the GlideExpression script. An unauthenticated user could exploit this vulnerability to execute code remotely.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Paessler PRTG Network Monitor Local File Inclusion Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Paessler PRTG Network Monitor contains a local file inclusion vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to create users with read-write privileges (including administrator).

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Paessler PRTG Network Monitor OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Paessler PRTG Network Monitor contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an attacker with administrative privileges to execute commands via the PRTG System Administrator web console.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Hitachi Vantara Pentaho BA Server Authorization Bypass Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Hitachi Vantara Pentaho BA Server contains a use of non-canonical URL paths for authorization decisions vulnerability that enables an attacker to bypass authorization.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Hitachi Vantara Pentaho BA Server Special Element Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Hitachi Vantara Pentaho BA Server contains a special element injection vulnerability that allows an attacker to inject Spring templates into properties files, allowing for arbitrary command execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Rejetto HTTP File Server Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Rejetto HTTP File Server contains an improper neutralization of special elements used in a template engine vulnerability. This allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute commands on the affected system by sending a specially crafted HTTP request.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Rejetto HTTP File Server (HFS) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: The findMacroMarker function in parserLib.pas in Rejetto HTTP File Server (HFS or HttpFileServer) allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary programs.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Grafana Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Grafana contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow access to local files.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Grafana Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Grafana contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated and unauthenticated users to view and delete all snapshot data, potentially resulting in complete snapshot data loss.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Array Networks AG and vxAG ArrayOS Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Array Networks AG and vxAG ArrayOS contain a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an attacker to read local files and execute code on the SSL VPN gateway.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Array Networks ArrayOS AG OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Array Networks ArrayOS AG contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: NUUO NVRmini Devices OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: NUUO NVRmini devices contain an OS command injection vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote command execution via shell metacharacters in the uploaddir parameter for a writeuploaddir command.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: NUUO NVRmini2 Devices Missing Authentication Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: NUUO NVRmini2 devices contain a missing authentication vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload an encrypted TAR archive, which can be abused to add arbitrary users.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ownCloud Improper Authentication Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: ownCloud contains an improper authentication vulnerability that allows an attacker to access, modify, or delete any file without authentication if the username of a victim is known, and the victim has no signing-key configured.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ownCloud graphapi Information Disclosure Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: ownCloud graphapi contains an information disclosure vulnerability that can reveal sensitive data stored in phpinfo() via GetPhpInfo.php, including administrative credentials.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX Insecure Direct Object Reference Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in RadAsyncUpload that can result in file uploads in a limited location and/or remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX Unrestricted File Upload Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Telerik.Web.UI in Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX allows remote attackers to perform arbitrary file uploads or execute arbitrary code.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Wing FTP Server Improper Neutralization of Null Byte or NUL Character Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Wing FTP Server contains an improper neutralization of null byte or NUL character vulnerability that can allow injection of arbitrary Lua code into user session files. This can be used to execute arbitrary system commands with the privileges of the FTP service (root or SYSTEM by default).

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Wing FTP Server Information Disclosure Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Wing FTP Server contains a generation of error message containing sensitive information vulnerability when using a long value in the UID cookie.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset Attack Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: HTTP/2 contains a rapid reset vulnerability that allows for a distributed denial-of-service attack (DDoS).

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Service Location Protocol (SLP) Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: The Service Location Protocol (SLP) contains a denial-of-service (DoS) vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to register services and use spoofed UDP traffic to conduct a denial-of-service (DoS) attack with a significant amplification factor.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Hikvision Multiple Products Improper Authentication Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Multiple Hikvision products contain an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a malicious user to escalate privileges on the system and gain access to sensitive information.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Hikvision Improper Input Validation
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: A command injection vulnerability in the web server of some Hikvision product. Due to the insufficient input validation.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: PEAR Archive_Tar Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: PEAR Archive_Tar allows an unserialization attack because phar: is blocked but PHAR: is not blocked. PEAR stands for PHP Extension and Application Repository and it is an open-source framework and distribution system for reusable PHP components with known usage in third-party products such as Drupal Core and Red Hat Linux.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: PEAR Archive_Tar Improper Link Resolution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: PEAR Archive_Tar Tar.php allows write operations with directory traversal due to inadequate checking of symbolic links. PEAR stands for PHP Extension and Application Repository and it is an open-source framework and distribution system for reusable PHP components with known usage in third-party products such as Drupal Core and Red Hat Linux.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Aviatrix Controllers OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Aviatrix Controllers contain an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code. Shell metacharacters can be sent to /v1/api in cloud_type for list_flightpath_destination_instances, or src_cloud_type for flightpath_connection_test.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Aviatrix Controller Unrestricted Upload of File
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Unrestricted upload of a file with a dangerous type is possible, which allows an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code via directory traversal.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: PTZOptics PT30X-SDI/NDI Cameras Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: PTZOptics PT30X-SDI/NDI cameras contain an insecure direct object reference (IDOR) vulnerability that allows a remote, attacker to bypass authentication for the /cgi-bin/param.cgi CGI script. If combined with CVE-2024-8957, this can lead to remote code execution as root.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: PTZOptics PT30X-SDI/NDI Cameras OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: PTZOptics PT30X-SDI/NDI cameras contain an OS command injection vulnerability that allows a remote, authenticated attacker to escalate privileges to root via a crafted payload with the ntp_addr parameter of the /cgi-bin/param.cgi CGI script.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Commvault Command Center Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Commvault Command Center contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Commvault Web Server Unspecified Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Commvault Web Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows a remote, authenticated attacker to create and execute webshells.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TIBCO JasperReports Library Directory Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: TIBCO JasperReports Library contains a directory-traversal vulnerability that may allow web server users to access contents of the host system.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TIBCO JasperReports Server Information Disclosure Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: TIBCO JasperReports Server contain a vulnerability which may allow any authenticated user read-only access to the contents of the web application, including key configuration files.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Versa Concerto Improper Authentication Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Versa Concerto SD-WAN orchestration platform contains an improper authentication vulnerability in the Traefik reverse proxy configuration, allowing at attacker to access administrative endpoints. The internal Actuator endpoint can be leveraged for access to heap dumps and trace logs.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Versa Director Dangerous File Type Upload Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: The Versa Director GUI contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows administrators with Provider-Data-Center-Admin or Provider-Data-Center-System-Admin privileges to customize the user interface. The “Change Favicon” (Favorite Icon) enables the upload of a .png file, which can be exploited to upload a malicious file with a .png extension disguised as an image.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: MongoDB and MongoDB Server Improper Handling of Length Parameter Inconsistency Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: MongoDB Server contains an improper handling of length parameter inconsistency vulnerability in Zlib compressed protocol headers. This vulnerability may allow a read of uninitialized heap memory by an unauthenticated client.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: MongoDB mongo-express Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: mongo-express before 0.54.0 is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution via endpoints that uses the `toBSON` method.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: MinIO Information Disclosure Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: MinIO contains a vulnerability in a cluster deployment where MinIO returns all environment variables, which allows for information disclosure.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: MinIO Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: MinIO contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that allows an attacker to use crafted requests to bypass metadata bucket name checking and put an object into any bucket while processing `PostPolicyBucket` to conduct privilege escalation. To carry out this attack, the attacker requires credentials with `arn:aws:s3:::*` permission, as well as enabled Console API access.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: MikroTik RouterOS Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: In MikroTik RouterOS, a stack-based buffer overflow occurs when processing NetBIOS session request messages. Remote attackers with access to the service can exploit this vulnerability and gain code execution on the system.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: MikroTik Router OS Directory Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: MikroTik RouterOS through 6.42 allows unauthenticated remote attackers to read arbitrary files and remote authenticated attackers to write arbitrary files due to a directory traversal vulnerability in the WinBox interface.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: OpenPLC ScadaBR Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: OpenPLC ScadaBR contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows remote authenticated users to upload and execute arbitrary JSP files via view_edit.shtm.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: OpenPLC ScadaBR Cross-site Scripting Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: OpenPLC ScadaBR contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability via system_settings.shtm.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Sudo Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Sudo contains an inclusion of functionality from untrusted control sphere vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow local attacker to leverage sudo’s -R (--chroot) option to run arbitrary commands as root, even if they are not listed in the sudoers file.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Sudo Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Sudo contains an off-by-one error that can result in a heap-based buffer overflow, which allows for privilege escalation.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Quest KACE System Management Appliance Remote Command Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: The '/common/download_agent_installer.php' script in the Quest KACE System Management Appliance is accessible by anonymous users and can be abused to perform remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Quest KACE Systems Management Appliance (SMA) Improper Authentication Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Quest KACE Systems Management Appliance (SMA) contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow attackers to impersonate legitimate users without valid credentials.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Advantive VeraCore SQL Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Advantive VeraCore contains a SQL injection vulnerability in timeoutWarning.asp that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary SQL commands via the PmSess1 parameter.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Advantive VeraCore Unrestricted File Upload Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Advantive VeraCore contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to upload files to unintended folders via upload.apsx.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: JFrog Artifactory Improper Authentication Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that under default configuration can allow an unauthenticated attacker with network access to obtain administrative privileges.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: JFrog Artifactory Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory vulnerability. This can allow an authenticated user to write data outside the intended Docker cache path under specific remote-repository conditions.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Dasan GPON Routers Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Dasan GPON Routers contain an authentication bypass vulnerability. When combined with CVE-2018-10561, exploitation can allow an attacker to perform remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Dasan GPON Routers Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Dasan GPON Routers contain an authentication bypass vulnerability. When combined with CVE-2018-10562, exploitation can allow an attacker to perform remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin contains privilege escalation vulnerability that is exposed via the user-end cPanel plugin, which can be abused by any cPanel user account to execute arbitrary scripts with root privileges.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin UNIX Symbolic Link (Symlink) Following Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: LiteSpeed cPanel plugin contains a UNIX symbolic link (Symlink) following vulnerability that could allow a user with FTP or web shell access on a shared hosting server running CloudLinux/CageFS.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: GeoVision Devices OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Multiple GeoVision devices contain an OS command injection vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to inject and execute arbitrary system commands. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: GeoVision Devices OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Multiple GeoVision devices contain an OS command injection vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to inject and execute arbitrary system commands. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Intel Ethernet Diagnostics Driver for Windows Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Intel ethernet diagnostics driver for Windows IQVW32.sys and IQVW64.sys contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for a denial-of-service (DoS).

topVulnerabilities.product: Active Management Technology (AMT), Small Business Technology (SBT), and Standard Manageability
topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Intel Active Management Technology (AMT), Small Business Technology (SBT), and Standard Manageability Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Intel products contain a vulnerability which can allow attackers to perform privilege escalation.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Reolink RLC-410W IP Camera OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Reolink RLC-410W IP cameras contain an authenticated OS command injection vulnerability in the device network settings functionality.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Reolink Multiple IP Cameras OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Reolink RLC-410W, C1 Pro, C2 Pro, RLC-422W, and RLC-511W IP cameras contain an authenticated OS command injection vulnerability. This vulnerability allows an authenticated admin to use the "TestEmail" functionality to inject and run OS commands as root.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Dell RecoverPoint for Virtual Machines (RP4VMs) Use of Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Dell RecoverPoint for Virtual Machines (RP4VMs) contains an use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the underlying operating system and root-level persistence.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Dell dbutil Driver Insufficient Access Control Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Dell dbutil driver contains an insufficient access control vulnerability which may lead to escalation of privileges, denial-of-service (DoS), or information disclosure.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator On-Prem OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator On-Prem contains an OS command injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Arista Extensible Operating System Incomplete Comparison with Missing Factors Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Arista Extensible Operating System (EOS) contains an incomplete comparison with missing factors vulnerability when the switch incorrectly decapsulate and forwards other unexpected tunneled packet with a destination IP matching its configured decapsulation IP.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ThinkPHP "noneCms" Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: ThinkPHP "noneCms" contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution through crafted use of the filter parameter.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ThinkPHP Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: ThinkPHP contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via public//?s=index/\think\app/invokefunction&function=call_user_func_array&vars[0]=system&vars[1][]= followed by the command.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: vBulletin PHP Module Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: The PHP module within vBulletin contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via the widgetConfig[code] parameter in an ajax/render/widget_php routestring request.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: vBulletin PHP Module Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: The PHP module within vBulletin contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via crafted subWidgets data in an ajax/render/widget_tabbedcontainer_tab_panel request. This CVE ID resolves an incomplete patch for CVE-2019-16759.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Unraid Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Unraid contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to gain access to the administrative interface. This CVE is chainable with CVE-2020-5847 for remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Unraid Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Unraid contains a vulnerability due to the insecure use of the extract PHP function that can be abused to execute remote code as root. This CVE is chainable with CVE-2020-5849 for initial access.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Sonatype Nexus Repository Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Sonatype Nexus Repository contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Sonatype Nexus Repository Manager Incorrect Access Control Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Sonatype Nexus Repository Manager before 3.15.0 has an incorrect access control vulnerability. Exploitation allows for remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zabbix Frontend Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Unsafe client-side session storage leading to authentication bypass/instance takeover via Zabbix Frontend with configured SAML.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zabbix Frontend Improper Access Control Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Malicious actors can pass step checks and potentially change the configuration of Zabbix Frontend.

topVulnerabilities.product: ProCurve Manager (PCM), PCM+, Identity Driven Manager (IDM), and Application Lifecycle Management
topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: HP Multiple Products Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: HP ProCurve Manager (PCM), PCM+, Identity Driven Manager (IDM), and Application Lifecycle Management allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a marshalled object to (1) EJBInvokerServlet or (2) JMXInvokerServlet.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: HP OpenView Network Node Manager Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: HP OpenView Network Node Manager could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the system.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: EyesOfNetwork Use of Hard-Coded Credentials Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: EyesOfNetwork contains a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability, as it uses the same API key by default. Exploitation allows an attacker to calculate or guess the admin access token.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: EyesOfNetwork Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: EyesOfNetwork contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that may allow a user to run commands as root via a crafted Nmap Scripting Engine (NSE) script to nmap7.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Micro Focus Operation Bridge Report (OBR) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Micro Focus Operation Bridge Report (OBR) contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Micro Focus Access Manager Information Leakage Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Micro Focus Access Manager contains an information leakage vulnerability resulting from a SAML service provider redirection issue when the Assertion Consumer Service URL is used.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Meta React Server Components Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Meta React Server Components contains a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated remote code execution by exploiting a flaw in how React decodes payloads sent to React Server Function endpoints. Please note CVE-2025-66478 has been rejected, but it is associated with CVE-2025- 55182.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: WebPros cPanel & WHM and WP2 (WordPress Squared) Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: WebPros cPanel & WHM (WebHost Manager) and WP2 (WordPress Squared) contain an authentication bypass vulnerability in the login flow that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to gain unauthorized access to the control panel.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: PHP-CGI OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: PHP, specifically Windows-based PHP used in CGI mode, contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for arbitrary code execution. This vulnerability is a patch bypass for CVE-2012-1823.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Samba Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Samba contains a remote code execution vulnerability, allowing a malicious client to upload a shared library to a writable share and then cause the server to load and execute it.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: dotCMS Unrestricted Upload of File Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: dotCMS ContentResource API contains an unrestricted upload of file with a dangerous type vulnerability that allows for directory traversal, in which the file is saved outside of the intended storage location. Exploitation allows for remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: NextGen Healthcare Mirth Connect Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: NextGen Healthcare Mirth Connect contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution via a specially crafted request.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Gitea Code Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Gitea contains a code injection vulnerability that allows an attacker with repository write access to send a malicious patch to the diffpatch API endpoint to plant an executable Git hook and run shell commands as the Gitea service account.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ZK Framework AuUploader Unspecified Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: ZK Framework AuUploader servlets contain an unspecified vulnerability that could allow an attacker to retrieve the content of a file located in the web context. The ZK Framework is an open-source Java framework. This vulnerability can impact multiple products, including but not limited to ConnectWise R1Soft Server Backup Manager.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ajax.NET Professional Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Ajax.NET Professional (AjaxPro) contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution via arbitrary .NET classes. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Splunk Enterprise Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Splunk Enterprise contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated user to create or truncate arbitrary files through a PostgreSQL sidecar service endpoint.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: XWiki Platform Eval Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: XWiki Platform contains an eval injection vulnerability that could allow any guest to perform arbitrary remote code execution through a request to SolrSearch.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TerraMaster OS Remote Command Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: TerraMaster OS contains a remote command execution vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to execute commands on the target endpoint.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: WebRTC Heap Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: WebRTC, an open-source project providing web browsers with real-time communication, contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to perform shellcode execution. This vulnerability impacts web browsers using WebRTC including but not limited to Google Chrome.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: PTC Windchill and FlexPLM Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: PTC Windchill and FlexPLM contains an improper input validation vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary code by sending a malicious request to the network.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Marimo Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Marimo contains an pre-authorization remote code execution vulnerability, allowing an unauthenticated attacked to shell access and execute arbitrary system commands.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: React Native Community CLI OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: React Native Community CLI contains an OS command injection vulnerability which could allow unauthenticated network attackers to send POST requests to the Metro Development Server and run arbitrary executables via a vulnerable endpoint exposed by the server. On Windows, attackers can also execute arbitrary shell commands with fully controlled arguments.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Widget Factory Joomla Content Editor Improper Access Control Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Widget Factory Joomla Content Editor contains an improper access control vulnerability which could allow for upload and execution of PHP code via the creation of new editor profiles for unauthenticated users.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: n8n Improper Control of Dynamically-Managed Code Resources Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: n8n contains an improper control of dynamically managed code resources vulnerability in its workflow expression evaluation system that allows for remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) OneView Code Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) OneView contains a code injection vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated user to perform remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Erlang Erlang/OTP SSH Server Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Erlang Erlang/OTP SSH server contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability. This could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands without valid credentials, potentially leading to unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE). By exploiting a flaw in how SSH protocol messages are handled, a malicious actor could gain unauthorized access to affected systems. This vulnerability could affect various products that implement Erlang/OTP SSH server, including—but not limited to—Cisco, NetApp, and SUSE.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Nostromo nhttpd Directory Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Nostromo nhttpd contains a directory traversal vulnerability in the http_verify() function in a non-chrooted nhttpd server allowing for remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Sunhillo SureLine OS Command Injection Vulnerablity
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Sunhillo SureLine contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an attacker to cause a denial-of-service or utilize the device for persistence on the network via shell metacharacters in ipAddr or dnsAddr in /cgi/networkDiag.cgi.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SolarView Compact Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: SolarView Compact contains a command injection vulnerability due to improper validation of input values on the send test mail console of the product's web server.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Multiple Ruckus Wireless Products CSRF and RCE Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Ruckus Wireless Access Point (AP) software contains an unspecified vulnerability in the web services component. If the web services component is enabled on the AP, an attacker can perform cross-site request forgery (CSRF) or remote code execution (RCE). This vulnerability impacts Ruckus ZoneDirector, SmartZone, and Solo APs.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Teclib GLPI Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Teclib GLPI contains a remote code execution vulnerability in the third-party library, htmlawed.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cacti Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Cacti contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to execute code.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Digiever DS-2105 Pro Missing Authorization Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Digiever DS-2105 Pro contains a missing authorization vulnerability which could allow for command injection via time_tzsetup.cgi.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Wazuh Server Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Wazuh contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows for remote code execution on Wazuh servers.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Nice Linear eMerge E3-Series OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Nice Linear eMerge E3-Series contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an attacker to conduct remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Smartbedded Meteobridge Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Smartbedded Meteobridge contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote unauthenticated attackers to gain arbitrary command execution with elevated privileges (root) on affected devices.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ProjectSend Improper Authentication Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: ProjectSend contains an improper authentication vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to enable unauthorized modification of the application's configuration via crafted HTTP requests to options.php. Successful exploitation allows attackers to create accounts, upload webshells, and embed malicious JavaScript.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Barracuda Networks ESG Appliance Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG) appliance contains an improper input validation vulnerability of a user-supplied .tar file, leading to remote command injection.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Yiiframework Yii Improper Protection of Alternate Path Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Yii Framework contains an improper protection of alternate path vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code. This vulnerability could affect other products that implement Yii, including—but not limited to—Craft CMS, as represented by CVE-2025-32432.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Netwrix Auditor Insecure Object Deserialization Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Netwrix Auditor User Activity Video Recording component contains an insecure objection deserialization vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute code as the NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM user. Successful exploitation requires that the attacker is able to reach port 9004/TCP, which is commonly blocked by standard enterprise firewalling.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: XStream Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: XStream contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows an attacker to manipulate the processed input stream and replace or inject objects that result in the execution of a local command on the server. This vulnerability can affect multiple products, including but not limited to VMware Cloud Foundation.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Omnissa Workspace ONE Server-Side Request Forgery
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Omnissa Workspace One UEM formerly known as VMware Workspace One UEM contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with network access to UEM to send their requests without authentication and to gain access to sensitive information.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: NAKIVO Backup and Replication Absolute Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: NAKIVO Backup and Replication contains an absolute path traversal vulnerability that enables an attacker to read arbitrary files.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Rockwell Multiple Products Insufficient Protected Credentials Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Multiple Rockwell products contain an insufficient protected credentials vulnerability. Studio 5000 Logix Designer software may allow a key to be discovered. This key is used to verify Logix controllers are communicating with Rockwell Automation design software. If successfully exploited, this vulnerability could allow an unauthorized application to connect with Logix controllers. To leverage this vulnerability, an unauthorized user would require network access to the controller.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Gogs Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Gogs contains a path traversal vulnerability affecting improper Symbolic link handling in the PutContents API that could allow for code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ignite Realtime Openfire Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Ignite Realtime Openfire contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to access restricted pages in the Openfire Admin Console reserved for administrative users.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Adminer Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Adminer contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that, when exploited, allows a remote attacker to obtain potentially sensitive information.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Edimax IC-7100 IP Camera OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Edimax IC-7100 IP camera contains an OS command injection vulnerability due to improper input sanitization that allows an attacker to achieve remote code execution via specially crafted requests. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Multiple SugarCRM Products Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Multiple SugarCRM products contain a remote code execution vulnerability in the EmailTemplates. Using a specially crafted request, custom PHP code can be injected through the EmailTemplates.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Aquasecurity Trivy Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Aquasecurity Trivy contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability that could allow an attacker to gain access to everything in the CI/CD environment, including all tokens, SSH keys, cloud credentials, database passwords, and any sensitive configuration in memory.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: AMI MegaRAC SPx Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: AMI MegaRAC SPx contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability in the Redfish Host Interface. A successful exploitation of this vulnerability may lead to a loss of confidentiality, integrity, and/or availability.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ZKTeco BioTime Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: ZKTeco BioTime contains a path traversal vulnerability in the iclock API that allows an unauthenticated attacker to read arbitrary files via supplying a crafted payload.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Nx Console Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Nx Console contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability that allowed a malicious version of Nx Console to be published. The compromised extension fetched an obfuscated payload that could harvested credentials from multiple sources on disk and in memory.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TanStack Unspecified Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: TanStack contains an unspecified vulnerability that allowed malicious versions of the product to be published to the npm registry to publish credential-stealing malware under a trusted identity.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: tj-actions/changed-files GitHub Action Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: tj-actions/changed-files GitHub Action contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to discover secrets by reading Github Actions Workflow Logs. These secrets may include, but are not limited to, valid AWS access keys, GitHub personal access tokens (PATs), npm tokens, and private RSA keys.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Acronis Cyber Infrastructure (ACI) Insecure Default Password Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Acronis Cyber Infrastructure (ACI) allows an unauthenticated user to execute commands remotely due to the use of default passwords.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Joomla! Improper Access Control Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Joomla! contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows unauthorized access to webservice endpoints.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Delta Electronics DOPSoft 2 Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Delta Electronics DOPSoft 2 lacks proper validation of user-supplied data when parsing specific project files (improper input validation) resulting in an out-of-bounds write that allows for code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Kestra OSS OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Kestra OSS contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to create and execute arbitrary workflows without credentials.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Joomlack Page Builder Improper Access Control Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Joomlack Page Builder contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution via unauthenticated arbitrary file upload.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: WSO2 Multiple Products Unrestrictive Upload of File Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Multiple WSO2 products allow for unrestricted file upload, resulting in remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Webmin Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: An issue was discovered in Webmin. The parameter old in password_change.cgi contains a command injection vulnerability.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ForgeRock Access Management (AM) Core Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: ForgeRock Access Management (AM) Core Server allows an attacker who sends a specially crafted HTTP request to one of three endpoints (/ccversion/Version, /ccversion/Masthead, or /ccversion/ButtonFrame) to execute code in the context of the current user (unless ForgeRock AM is running as root user, which the vendor does not recommend).

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Kludex Starlette HTTP Request/Response Smuggling Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Kludex Starlette contains a HTTP request/response smuggling vulnerability that could allow attackers to inject paths into the host part, prepending the actual path leading to issues such as authentication bypass when the authentication depends on the reconstructed URL’s path. This vulnerability could be chaned with CVE-2026-42271.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: MLflow Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: MLflow contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that can allow attackers to reach internal or cloud metadata services and receive response_status and response_body.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ray-Project Ray Code Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Ray-Project Ray contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow remote code execution. Developers using Ray as a development tool may be exposed to this vulnerability exploitable through Firefox and Safari.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Vite Vitejs Improper Access Control Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Vite Vitejs contains an improper access control vulnerability that exposes content of non-allowed files using ?inline&import or ?raw?import. Only apps explicitly exposing the Vite dev server to the network (using --host or server.host config option) are affected.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: JQuery Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: JQuery contains a persistent cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability. When passing maliciously formed, untrusted input enclosed in HTML tags, JQuery's DOM manipulators can execute untrusted code in the context of the user's browser.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows an attacker with access to the server administrator's Plex account to upload a malicious file via the Camera Upload feature and have the media server execute it.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: iCagenda Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: iCagenda contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows the upload of arbitrary files in the file attachment feature, ultimately resulting in PHP code upload and execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Lantronix EDS5000 Code Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Lantronix EDS5000 contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow attackers to inject arbitrary OS commands into the username parameter. Injected commands are executed with root privileges.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: FXC AE1021, AE1021PE OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: FXC AE1021 and AE1021PE contain an OS command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to execute commands via a network.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Balbooa Forms Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Balbooa Forms contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated arbitrary file upload which could allow uploading of executable files leading to full RCE.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: JoomShaper SP Page Builder Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: JoomShaper SP Page Builder contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows unauthenticated users to upload arbitrary files, ultimately resulting in the upload and execution of PHP code.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Mirasvit Full Page Cache Warmer Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Mirasvit Full Page Cache Warmer contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by supplying a crafted serialized PHP object in the CacheWarmer cookie.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: 7-Zip Mark of the Web Bypass Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: 7-Zip contains a protection mechanism failure vulnerability that allows remote attackers to bypass the Mark-of-the-Web security feature to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current user.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SKYSEA Client View Improper Authentication Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: SKYSEA Client View contains an improper authentication vulnerability that allows remote code execution via a flaw in processing authentication on the TCP connection with the management console program.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Multi-Router Looking Glass (MRLG) Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Multi-Router Looking Glass (MRLG) contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause an arbitrary memory write and memory corruption.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Sierra Wireless AirLink ALEOS Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Sierra Wireless AirLink ALEOS contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability. A specially crafted HTTP request can upload a file, resulting in executable code being uploaded, and routable, to the webserver. An attacker can make an authenticated HTTP request to trigger this vulnerability. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: BQE BillQuick Web Suite SQL Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: BQE BillQuick Web Suite contains an SQL injection vulnerability when accessing the username parameter that may allow for unauthenticated, remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Trimble Cityworks Deserialization Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Trimble Cityworks contains a deserialization vulnerability. This could allow an authenticated user to perform a remote code execution attack against a customer's Microsoft Internet Information Services (IIS) web server.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Motex LANSCOPE Endpoint Manager Improper Verification of Source of a Communication Channel Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Motex LANSCOPE Endpoint Manager contains an improper verification of source of a communication channel vulnerability allowing an attacker to execute arbitrary code by sending specially crafted packets.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: FreeType Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: FreeType contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability when attempting to parse font subglyph structures related to TrueType GX and variable font files that may allow for arbitrary code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Justice AV Solutions (JAVS) Viewer Installer Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Justice AV Solutions (JAVS) Viewer installer contains a malicious version of ffmpeg.exe, named fffmpeg.exe (SHA256: 421a4ad2615941b177b6ec4ab5e239c14e62af2ab07c6df1741e2a62223223c4). When run, this creates a backdoor connection to a malicious C2 server.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: DD-WRT Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: DD-WRT contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to overflow an internal buffer used by UPnP and trigger a code execution vulnerability.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Daemon Tools Lite Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Daemon Tools contains an unspecified vulnerability that has a high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Qualitia Active! Mail Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Qualitia Active! Mail contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary or trigger a denial-of-service via a specially crafted request.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Novi Survey Insecure Deserialization Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Novi Survey contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code on the server in the context of the service account.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Soliton Systems K.K FileZen OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Soliton Systems K.K FileZen contains an OS command injection vulnerability when an user logs-in to the affected product and sends a specially crafted HTTP request.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Acclaim Systems USAHERDS Use of Hard-Coded Credentials Vulnerability
