topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Acclaim Systems USAHERDS contains a hard-coded credentials vulnerability that could allow an attacker to achieve remote code execution on the system that runs the application. The MachineKey must be obtained via a separate vulnerability or other channel.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ScienceLogic SL1 Unspecified Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: ScienceLogic SL1 (formerly EM7) is affected by an unspecified vulnerability involving an unspecified third-party component.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Kingsoft WPS Office Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Kingsoft WPS Office contains a path traversal vulnerability in promecefpluginhost.exe on Windows that allows an attacker to load an arbitrary Windows library.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Spreadsheet::ParseExcel Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Spreadsheet::ParseExcel contains a remote code execution vulnerability due to passing unvalidated input from a file into a string-type “eval”. Specifically, the issue stems from the evaluation of Number format strings within the Excel parsing logic.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Unitronics Vision PLC and HMI Insecure Default Password Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Unitronics Vision Series PLCs and HMIs ship with an insecure default password, which if left unchanged, can allow attackers to execute remote commands.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: OpenSSL Information Disclosure Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: The TLS and DTLS implementations in OpenSSL do not properly handle Heartbeat Extension packets, which allows remote attackers to obtain sensitive information.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Crestron Multiple Products Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Multiple Crestron products are vulnerable to command injection via the file_transfer.cgi HTTP endpoint. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can use this vulnerability to execute operating system commands as root.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Debian-specific Redis Server Lua Sandbox Escape Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Redis is prone to a (Debian-specific) Lua sandbox escape, which could result in remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: OpenSMTPD Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: smtp_mailaddr in smtp_session.c in OpenSMTPD, as used in OpenBSD and other products, allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands as root via a crafted SMTP session.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: PHPUnit Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: PHPUnit allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary PHP code via HTTP POST data beginning with a "<?php " substring, as demonstrated by an attack on a site with an exposed /vendor folder, i.e., external access to the /vendor/phpunit/phpunit/src/Util/PHP/eval-stdin.php URI.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ExifTool Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Improper neutralization of user data in the DjVu file format in Exiftool versions 7.44 and up allows arbitrary code execution when parsing the malicious image

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Arcadyan Buffalo Firmware Path Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Arcadyan Buffalo firmware contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated, remote attackers to bypass authentication and access sensitive information. This vulnerability affects multiple routers across several different vendors.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Liferay Portal Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Liferay Portal contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code via JSON web services.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: KNX Association KNX Protocol Connection Authorization Option 1 Overly Restrictive Account Lockout Mechanism Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: KNX Association KNX Protocol Connection Authorization Option 1 contains an overly restrictive account lockout mechanism vulnerability that could allow an attacker to purge all devices without additional security options enabled and set a BCU key to lock the device.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Artifex Ghostscript Type Confusion Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Artifex Ghostscript allows -dSAFER bypass and remote command execution via .rsdparams type confusion with a "/OutputFile.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Alcatel OmniPCX Enterprise Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: masterCGI in the Unified Maintenance Tool in Alcatel OmniPCX Enterprise Communication Server allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: phpMyAdmin Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Setup script used to generate configuration can be fooled using a crafted POST request to include arbitrary PHP code in generated configuration file.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Primetek Primefaces Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Primetek Primefaces is vulnerable to a weak encryption flaw resulting in remote code execution

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Embedthis GoAhead Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Embedthis GoAhead before 3.6.5 allows remote code execution if CGI is enabled and a CGI program is dynamically linked.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TVT NVMS-1000 Directory Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: TVT devices utilizing NVMS-1000 software contain a directory traversal vulnerability via GET /.. requests.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Prettier eslint-config-prettier Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Prettier eslint-config-prettier contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability. Installing an affected package executes an install.js file that launches the node-gyp.dll malware on Windows.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Srimax Output Messenger Directory Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Srimax Output Messenger contains a directory traversal vulnerability that allows an attacker to access sensitive files outside the intended directory, potentially leading to configuration leakage or arbitrary file access.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Dante Discovery Process Control Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Dante Discovery contains a process control vulnerability in mDNSResponder.exe that all allows for a DLL sideloading attack. A local attacker can leverage this vulnerability in the Dante Application Library to execute arbitrary code.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: LG N1A1 NAS Remote Command Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: LG N1A1 NAS 3718.510 is affected by a remote code execution vulnerability.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: October CMS Improper Authentication
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: In affected versions of the october/system package an attacker can request an account password reset and then gain access to the account using a specially crafted request.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: System Information Library for Node.JS Command Injection
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: In this vulnerability, an attacker can send a malicious payload that will exploit the name parameter. After successful exploitation, attackers can execute remote.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Fuel CMS SQL Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: FUEL CMS 1.4.7 allows SQL Injection via the col parameter to /pages/items, /permissions/items, or /navigation/items.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Notepad++ Download of Code Without Integrity Check Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Notepad++ when using the WinGUp updater, contains a download of code without integrity check vulnerability that could allow an attacker to intercept or redirect update traffic to download and execute an attacker-controlled installer. This could lead to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the user.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Git Link Following Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Git contains a link following vulnerability that stems from Git’s inconsistent handling of carriage return characters in configuration files.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: reviewdog/action-setup GitHub Action Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: reviewdog action-setup GitHub Action contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability that dumps exposed secrets to Github Actions Workflow Logs.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Code Aurora ACDB Audio Driver Stack-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: The Code Aurora audio calibration database (acdb) audio driver contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation. Code Aurora is used in third-party products such as Qualcomm and Android.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link and TRENDnet Multiple Devices Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: The ping tool in multiple D-Link and TRENDnet devices allow remote attackers to perform remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Grandstream Networks UCM6200 Series SQL Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Grandstream UCM6200 series is vulnerable to an unauthenticated remote SQL injection via crafted HTTP request. Exploitation can allow for code execution as root.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: PlaySMS Server-Side Template Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: PlaySMS contains a server-side template injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Yealink Device Management Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Yealink Device Management contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TeamT5 ThreatSonar Anti-Ransomware Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: TeamT5 ThreatSonar Anti-Ransomware contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability. ThreatSonar Anti-Ransomware does not properly validate the content of uploaded files. Remote attackers with administrator privileges on the product platform can upload malicious files, which can be used to execute arbitrary system commands on the server.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: North Grid Proself Improper Restriction of XML External Entity (XXE) Reference Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: North Grid Proself Enterprise/Standard, Gateway, and Mail Sanitize contain an improper restriction of XML External Entity (XXE) reference vulnerability, which could allow a remote, unauthenticated attacker to conduct an XXE attack.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Pi-Hole AdminLTE Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Pi-hole Web v4.3.2 (aka AdminLTE) allows Remote Code Execution by privileged dashboard users via a crafted DHCP static lease.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: rConfig OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: rConfig lib/ajaxHandlers/ajaxAddTemplate.php contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute OS commands via shell metacharacters in the fileName POST parameter.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: MDaemon Email Server Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: MDaemon Email Server contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to load arbitrary JavaScript code via an HTML e-mail message.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Schneider Electric U.motion Builder SQL Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: A SQL Injection vulnerability exists in U.motion Builder software which could cause unwanted code execution when an improper set of characters is entered.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: InduSoft Web Studio NTWebServer Directory Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: InduSoft Web Studio NTWebServer contains a directory traversal vulnerability that allows remote attackers to read administrative passwords in APP files, allowing for remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ChakraCore Scripting Engine Type Confusion Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: The ChakraCore scripting engine contains a type confusion vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Libraesva Email Security Gateway Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Libraesva Email Security Gateway (ESG) contains a command injection vulnerability which allows command injection via a compressed e-mail attachment.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Arcserve Unified Data Protection (UDP) Directory Traversal Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Directory traversal vulnerability in Arcserve UDP allows remote attackers to obtain sensitive information or cause a denial of service.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: IGEL OS Use of a Key Past its Expiration Date Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: IGEL OS contains a use of a key past its expiration date vulnerability that allows for Secure Boot bypass. The igel-flash-driver module improperly verifies a cryptographic signature. Ultimately, a crafted root filesystem can be mounted from an unverified SquashFS image.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Twilio Authy Information Disclosure Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Twilio Authy contains an information disclosure vulnerability in its API that allows an unauthenticated endpoint to accept a request containing a phone number and respond with information about whether the phone number was registered with Authy.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: FatPipe WARP, IPVPN, and MPVPN Configuration Upload exploit
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: A vulnerability in the web management interface of FatPipe WARP, IPVPN, and MPVPN software allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to upload a file to any location on the filesystem.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Pulse Connect Secure Code Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: A code injection vulnerability exists in Pulse Connect Secure that allows an attacker to crafted a URI to perform an arbitrary code execution via the admin web interface.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Amcrest Cameras and NVR Stack-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Amcrest cameras and NVR contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability through port 37777 that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to crash the device and possibly execute code.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Symantec Messaging Gateway Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Symantec Messaging Gateway contains an unspecified vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution. With the ability to perform remote code execution, an attacker may also desire to perform privilege escalating actions.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Trihedral VTScada (formerly VTS) Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: The WAP interface in Trihedral VTScada (formerly VTS) allows remote attackers to cause a denial-of-service (DoS).

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Checkbox Survey Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in CheckboxWeb.dll of Checkbox Survey allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Docker Desktop Community Edition Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Docker Desktop Community Edition contains a vulnerability that may allow local users to escalate privileges by placing a trojan horse docker-credential-wincred.exe file in %PROGRAMDATA%\DockerDesktop\version-bin\.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Netis WF2419 Devices Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Netis WF2419 devices contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to perform remote code execution as root through the router's web management page.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Treck TCP/IP stack Out-of-Bounds Read Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: The Treck TCP/IP stack contains an IPv6 out-of-bounds read vulnerability.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Sumavision EMR Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Sumavision Enhanced Multimedia Router (EMR) contains a cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability allowing the creation of users with elevated privileges as administrator on a device.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Siemens SIMATIC CP 1543-1 Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: An improper privilege management vulnerability exists within the Siemens SIMATIC Communication Processor (CP) that allows a privileged attacker to remotely cause a denial of service.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SIMalliance Toolbox Browser Command Injection Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: SIMalliance Toolbox Browser contains an command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to retrieve location and IMEI information or execute a range of other attacks by modifying the attack message.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TeamViewer Desktop Bypass Remote Login Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: TeamViewer Desktop allows for bypass of remote-login access control because the same AES key is used for different customers' installations. If an attacker were to know this key, they could decrypt protected information stored in registry or configuration files or decryption of the Unattended Access password to the system (which allows for remote login to the system).

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: WebKitGTK Memory Corruption Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: WebKitGTK contains a memory corruption vulnerability which can allow an attacker to perform remote code execution.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: QNAP Helpdesk Improper Access Control Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: QNAP Helpdesk contains an improper access control vulnerability which could allow an attacker to gain privileges or to read sensitive information.

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Mediatek Multiple Chipsets Insufficient Input Validation Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: Multiple MediaTek chipsets contain an insufficient input validation vulnerability and have missing SELinux restrictions in the Command Queue drivers ioctl handlers. This causes an out-of-bounds write leading to privilege escalation. This vulnerability was observed chained with CVE-2019-2215 and CVE-2020-0041 under exploit chain "AbstractEmu."

topVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: McAfee Total Protection (MTP) Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
topVulnerabilities.shortDescription: McAfee Total Protection (MTP) contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that allows a local user to gain elevated privileges and execute code, bypassing MTP self-defense.
